description: This file defines a factory class HomeViewModelFactory for creating instances of HomeViewModel with dependency injection, specifically injecting a ContentRepository. It implements ViewModelProvider.Factory to facilitate ViewModel creation in an Android MVVM architecture.

classes.name: HomeViewModelFactory
classes.description: A ViewModel factory that creates HomeViewModel instances with dependency injection of ContentRepository.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of HomeViewModel if the requested modelClass is assignable from HomeViewModel.
